titulo_da: Læsning 1 · Få nogen til at gøre noget
titulo_es: A task that someone does · Make someone do something

texto: The «få nogen til at + infinitivo» construction expresses that someone gets or causes someone else to do something. The main verb appears in infinitive after «til at».
Read the header and locate the data that answers the question.
